title: Death end re;Quest 2
synopsis: Compile Heart’s horror RPG sequel set in the town of Le Choara — retained as Idea Factory International’s Nintendo Switch game card.

catalog.mediumForm: Nintendo Switch game card · retail edition

custody.physical: Nintendo Switch game card in retail case

curatorNotes:
Death end re;Quest 2 follows Mai Toyama, who flees her past to the mountain town of Le Choara to search for her missing sister, investigating by day and fighting creatures of the Darkness by night.

It released on PlayStation 4 in Japan in February 2020. The Nintendo Switch version was download-only in Japan; Idea Factory International issued it physically in North America on February 8, 2022.

The filing follows the first game in the Death end re;Quest lineage.
collectionNotes:
The retained object is Idea Factory International’s retail edition of Death end re;Quest 2 on a Nintendo Switch game card.

Dedicated artifact views of the individual copy have not yet been filed; the gallery below is held open for that documentation.

preservation.playableOn: Nintendo Switch; compatible Nintendo Switch family hardware
preservation.compatibility: Nintendo Switch software is region-free. The retained game card is the primary access copy and runs on any Nintendo Switch console.
preservation.concerns: Game cards are flash media; long-term charge retention, contact wear, and loss of the small card from its case are the principal risks. Any content delivered as an eShop download or update depends on Nintendo’s servers and is not preserved by the card alone.
preservation.knownRevisions: PlayStation 4 release in Japan on February 13, 2020; North America August 25, 2020. Nintendo Switch release in North America on February 8, 2022 (HAC-P-A4TRB); Europe February 11, 2022.
preservation.availability: Distributed at retail by Idea Factory International, with a digital edition on the Nintendo eShop.
